explanation.en: “designed to last around 25 years” → 25 years. “1990s” is when the first farms were built.
explanation.kk: «designed to last around 25 years» → 25 years. «1990s» — алғашқы станциялар салынған кезең.
explanation.ru: «designed to last around 25 years» → 25 years. «1990s» — время постройки первых ферм.

RT-AC-SC-M-Q1.quote: Wind turbines are designed to last around 25 years

explanation.en: “the steel tower and the copper wiring, can be recycled easily” → copper wiring. The “blades” are what is hard to recycle.
explanation.kk: «the steel tower and the copper wiring, can be recycled easily» → copper wiring. «Blades» — өңдеуі қиын бөлік.
explanation.ru: «the steel tower and the copper wiring, can be recycled easily» → copper wiring. «Blades» — как раз то, что перерабатывать трудно.

RT-AC-SC-M-Q2.quote: including the steel tower and the copper wiring, can be recycled easily

explanation.en: “chosen because it is light and strong enough” → strong. “Light” is already in the sentence.
explanation.kk: «chosen because it is light and strong enough» → strong. «Light» сөйлемде тұр.
explanation.ru: «chosen because it is light and strong enough» → strong. «Light» уже в предложении.

RT-AC-SC-M-Q3.quote: a combination chosen because it is light and strong enough to survive decades of storms

explanation.en: “cut into pieces and buried in landfill sites” → landfill sites (“landfill” is also accepted).
explanation.kk: «cut into pieces and buried in landfill sites» → landfill sites (landfill да есептеледі).
explanation.ru: «cut into pieces and buried in landfill sites» → landfill sites (засчитывается и landfill).

explanation.en: “mixed into cement, replacing some of the sand and clay” → cement. “Sand” and “clay” are already there as what is replaced.
explanation.kk: «mixed into cement, replacing some of the sand and clay» → cement. «Sand» мен «clay» сөйлемде тұр — алмастырылатын нәрселер.
explanation.ru: «mixed into cement, replacing some of the sand and clay» → cement. «Sand» и «clay» уже в предложении — это то, что заменяют.

RT-AC-SC-M-Q5.quote: small pieces that are mixed into cement, replacing some of the sand and clay normally used

explanation.en: The resin breaks down when heated “in the absence of oxygen”. “Without” means “in the absence of”, so the answer is oxygen; 500 degrees is the temperature, not what is missing.
explanation.kk: Шайырды «in the absence of oxygen» қыздыру ыдыратады. Сөйлемдегі «without» — «in the absence of» дегені, сондықтан жауап oxygen; 500 degrees — жоқ нәрсе емес, температура.
explanation.ru: Смолу разрушает нагрев «in the absence of oxygen». «Without» в предложении значит «in the absence of», поэтому ответ oxygen; 500 degrees — температура, а не то, чего нет.

RT-AC-SC-M-Q6.quote: in the absence of oxygen, which breaks down the resin

explanation.en: “used as roofs for bicycle shelters” → bicycle shelters. The bridge is in Ireland, not Denmark.
explanation.kk: «used as roofs for bicycle shelters» → bicycle shelters. Көпір — Дания емес, Ирландия.
explanation.ru: «used as roofs for bicycle shelters» → bicycle shelters. Мост — это Ирландия, а не Дания.

RT-AC-SC-M-Q7.quote: sections have been used as roofs for bicycle shelters

explanation.en: “using two blades as its main beams” → beams, plural: there are two blades.
explanation.kk: «using two blades as its main beams» → beams, көпше түрде: қалақ екеу.
explanation.ru: «using two blades as its main beams» → beams, во множественном числе: лопастей две.

RT-AC-SC-M-Q8.quote: a pedestrian bridge was built using two blades as its main beams

explanation.en: “can be dissolved in a mild acid” → mild acid. “A” is already in the sentence, so do not repeat it.
explanation.kk: «can be dissolved in a mild acid» → mild acid. «A» сөйлемде тұр, оны қайталаудың керегі жоқ.
explanation.ru: «can be dissolved in a mild acid» → mild acid. «A» уже есть в предложении, повторять артикль не нужно.

RT-AC-SC-M-Q9.quote: A new type of resin can be dissolved in a mild acid

explanation.en: “The first blades made in this way were installed in 2022” → 2022. The “1990s” in paragraph A refers to the first wind farms.
explanation.kk: «The first blades made in this way were installed in 2022» → 2022. A абзацындағы «1990s» — алғашқы жел электр станциялары.
explanation.ru: «The first blades made in this way were installed in 2022» → 2022. «1990s» из абзаца A — первые ветряные фермы.
